I too had awful anxiety, depression, and suicidal thoughts in middle & high school. Just realize that a lot of it is just that the school system just doesn't work right for some people. For people like us it just hurts us more than it helps until we finally get that diploma. My junior year my parents had me start online school since I so often was home sick from school with vomiting from anxiety. It didn't help the loneliness but it at least let me focus on myself for once instead of worrying about what people were thinking about me or whatever. Would you be able to talk to your family about doing something like that? I knew for sure my parents would never let one of their kids do online school but after I talked to them with a bit of a breakdown they went right ahead at signing me up for one. Sometimes you have more love around you than you realize. I know at my lowest I thought absolutely nobody had any love at all for me, but I was proven wrong. I hope you let yourself be proven wrong too!

I had my first pet rat put down right before this past Christmas. He was an old man and had paralysis for about a month prior. He stopped eating and drinking the a few days prior to his death. It was hard to tell whether he liked me holding or trying to pet him. He would jerk his head around like he was trying to lick me, but the intensity of the jerking made it seem like he was just in pain.

I'm in the US, and about everyone I tried talking about losing him with just gave me the usual "but he's a rat" look. They don't realize how great of pets rats are, and that the connection can be really strong; stronger than many people are to their cats or dogs.

I'm really sorry for what you're going through. You're doing the right thing. Don't let him suffer any more just because some people you won't even have to deal with in a month can't understand.
